description: List the ~460 software products endoflife.date tracks (languages, frameworks, OSes, databases, devices) as slugs. These slugs feed get_product and get_cycle. Keyless. Use the `search` filter to find one ("postgres", "ubuntu", "node").

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over product slugs, e.g. "post" matches "postgresql". Optional.

name: list_products
title: List Products
